unlisted_practices: Research-informed prompting (referencing of deep research prompt, zero-shot chain-of-thought, atom-of-thoughts) to improve LLM prediction of antidepressant remission
Psychiatrist Likert-scale rating of LLM-generated rationales for correctness, consistency, specificity, helpfulness, and human likeness
Use of high negative predictive value to identify likely nonresponders to antidepressant monotherapy

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates reasoning-based LLM prompting approaches for predicting antidepressant remission on retrospective patient cohort data, including expert clinician assessment of generated rationales, but does not test an organizational deployment safeguard or practice.
